issues: No attempt to get around the measurement: the diff reads no files, contains no pasted coordinates, draws all randomness from the seeded rng, and leaves the time check unchanged.

No bug makes the result meaningless. The shaken warm start still goes through SLSQP, clipping and _repair, so the harness's validity check still applies. The added cost of _shake (40 steps of O(n^2) numpy for n=26) is negligible and stays within the TIME_FRACTION loop.

Possible weakness, not a veto: the elliptical stretch s0 in _solve_once is still drawn and applied when a warm start is given. Depending on the unseen lines that use it, this may distort the shaken best packing and weaken the warm start.

Recomputed z, assuming sd 0.0023 per run: diff = 0.0001 in favour of the candidate; SE = 0.0023*sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) = 0.00282; z = 0.035. The reported 0.046 is within the rounding of the 4-decimal means: any diff from 0.00005 to 0.00015 gives z from 0.018 to 0.053. The numbers agree.
Only one candidate run, and the difference is far below the noise. The provisional reject is consistent with the numbers.
